description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Galazeth Prismari.
When Galazeth Prismari enters the battlefield, it triggers once, and Preston triggers twice.
Resolve the Galazeth Prismari trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Galazeth Prismari that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Galazeth Prismari token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
